repairs.issue: Concurrent identical InitWorkspaceV1 could return AlreadyInitialized after waiting for BEGIN IMMEDIATE instead of replaying the recorded bootstrap receipt.
repairs.change: Inside the serialized init transaction, re-verify identity and consult bootstrap_receipts for the operation ID before returning AlreadyInitialized.
repairs.contract_basis: Repeated identical init returns its recorded result.

repairs.issue: StateStore::open created schema before rejecting an unsupported linked SQLite version, and configured durability PRAGMAs before rejecting an unauthorized existing identity.
repairs.change: Run a non-mutating linked SQLite version gate before ensure_schema; on existing stores verify owner/workspace/replica identity before configure_connection.
repairs.contract_basis: Runtime engine gate precedes writes; unauthorized scope must not acquire a mutation path.
